name: Media helpers use Runner for external commands
instruction: Media helper files must use the package Runner abstraction instead of directly executing external commands.
relevant_when: A non-test Go source file under work-journal/internal/media other than exec.go.
context: The media package wraps command-line tools such as afconvert, whisper-cli, sips, file, and afinfo. Keeping direct os/exec usage in exec.go lets tests stub those tools through media.Runner instead of spawning real processes.
scope_reason: Each media helper file either contains direct external command execution or delegates through Runner, so one file has enough evidence for this invariant.

checklist.name: no-direct-os-exec
checklist.rule: The file does not import os/exec and does not call exec.Command or exec.CommandContext directly. Calls through a Runner value are acceptable. If this is exec.go or a test file, return not applicable.
